items.title: Network & Application Protocols Reference — The Complete Protocol Guide
items.description: Comprehensive reference for all essential network and application protocols — TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, QUIC, WebSocket, SSH, FTP/SFTP, SMTP/IMAP, TLS 1.3, BGP, MQTT, and AMQP.

items.title: OSI & TCP/IP Models
